title: Context and memory in the makerspace assistant

items.stem: Your assistant's program makes its third model call in a request. Which statement about what the model has available on that call is correct?

options.text: It keeps its own memory of calls one and two between calls
It has only what the program sent in this call's context
It reads the booking system directly, without any tool call
It holds the whole manual library permanently after training

items.stem: A request takes ten steps, and the program re-sends the whole message list at every step. In one sentence, why does the cost of the last step exceed the cost of the first step?
A student closes the chat on Monday and opens a new chat on Wednesday. The team wants the assistant to know the student is trained on the laser cutter. What is the right design?

options.text: Choose a model with a larger window, which keeps old chats
Keep the Monday chat open on the server and send it again
Write the training status to storage and load it into context
Tell the model in the system prompt to remember every student

items.stem: Your team has a 600-page library of machine manuals and a small model budget. Which approach to answering a student's question about one machine fits best?

options.text: Put all 600 pages into the system prompt on every call
Search the manuals and put only the best few passages in context
Put the first 20 pages of each manual into the system prompt
Ask the student to paste the right manual page into the chat

items.stem: The booking calendar already records every reservation. A teammate proposes also saving each student's current bookings as a note for the assistant to read next visit. Give one reason this could cause a problem.
